item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena measures the temperature of warm milk in a steel vessel using a laboratory thermometer at her home in Pune.
Which method gives the correct reading?

options.A: Dip only the tip of the thermometer in the milk and read it immediately.
options.B: Immerse the bulb fully in the milk without touching the vessel, wait until the column stops rising, and read at eye level with the bulb still in the milk.
options.C: Rest the bulb on the bottom of the vessel so the thermometer stays steady, then read.
options.D: Take the thermometer out of the milk, wait for one minute, and then read the column.
